get() {
  grep "^$1=" "$SUM" 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 | cut -d= -f2 || true
}

handshake_age_seconds() {
  iface="$1"
  hs="$(awg show "$iface" 2>/dev/null | grep 'latest handshake' | sed 's/.*latest handshake: //' || true)"

  if [ -z "$hs" ]; then
    echo "999999"
    return
  fi

  python3 - "$hs" <<'PY'
import sys, re
s = sys.argv[1]
total = 0
for n, unit in re.findall(r'(\d+)\s+(day|hour|minute|second)', s):
    n = int(n)
    if unit == "day":
        total += n * 86400
    elif unit == "hour":
        total += n * 3600
    elif unit == "minute":
        total += n * 60
    elif unit == "second":
        total += n
print(total if total else 999999)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

REG="/opt/v7/egress/state/egress.registry"
HIST="/opt/v7/egress/state/egress-history.jsonl"

STAB="/opt/v7/egress/state/stability.state"
STAB_TMP="${STAB}.tmp.$$"

WINDOW=30

to_mbps() {
  awk -v b="$1" 'BEGIN { printf "%.2f", (b*8)/1000000 }'
}

calc_stats() {
  field="$1"

  vals=$(
    grep -o "\"${field}\":\"[0-9][0-9]*\"" "$HIST" 2>/dev/null \
      | cut -d'"' -f4 \
      | tail -n "$WINDOW"
  )

  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  count=0
  sum=0

  for v in $vals; do
    [ -z "$v" ] && continue
    [ "$v" = "0" ] && continue

    mbps=$(to_mbps "$v")
    echo "$mbps" >> "$tmp"
    sum=$(awk -v a="$sum" -v b="$mbps" 'BEGIN {print a+b}')
    count=$((count+1))
  done

  if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
    rm -f "$tmp"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

[ -r "$LIB" ] && . "$LIB"
if command -v v7_load_policy_env >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  v7_load_policy_env
fi
SOFT_LIMIT="${V7_LOAD_SOFT_LIMIT:-1}"
HARD_LIMIT="${V7_LOAD_HARD_LIMIT:-2}"

OUT="${STATE_DIR}/egress-load.state"
TMP="${OUT}.tmp.$$"

touch "$TMP"
echo "updated=$(date -Is)" > "$TMP"

while read -r line; do
  [ -z "$line" ] && continue
  case "$line" in \#*) continue ;; esac
  id="$(v7_kv_get "$line" id)"
  enabled="$(v7_kv_get "$line" enabled)"
  [ "${enabled:-0}" != "1" ] && continue

  count=$(grep -c "current=${id}" "$USERS_REG" 2>/dev/null || true)

  soft_limit="$SOFT_LIMIT"
  hard_limit="$HARD_LIMIT"

  if [ "$count" -ge "$hard_limit" ]; then
    load_status="HARD_FULL"
  elif [ "$count" -ge "$soft_limit" ]; then
    load_status="SOFT_FULL"
  else
    load_status="OK"
  fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash

TMP="${OUT}.tmp.$$"

  [ -f "$f" ] || continue

  while read -r line; do
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue

    key="${line%%=*}"

    grep -v "^${key}=" "$TMP" > "${TMP}.2" || true
    echo "$line" >> "${TMP}.2"
    mv "${TMP}.2" "$TMP"

  done < "$f"
done

mv "$TMP" "$OUT"

echo "===== MERGED SUMMARY ====="
